title: Correct evidence association
historyEmpty: No association corrections have been recorded.
name: Evidence title
help: Correct only this record's association. Original bytes, older associations and exact references remain available. A reason is retained in the association history.
removed: This association was removed from current evidence. This retained revision and its original download remain available.
older: You are inspecting an older revision. Open the current evidence to make a correction.
reviewHelp: Review the action, exact revision, file hash and reason. Reassignment creates or reuses the replacement association and removes this association in one transaction.
required: Enter a correction reason and choose a replacement record when reassigning evidence.
changed: The evidence view changed. Reopen the correction before continuing.
